prompts.label: Home reference
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished wide desktop application UI design reference for Wilco, a meeting notetaker and team task follow-up tool. This is an actual working application screen, not a marketing landing page.
Input image is the approved mascot and the authoritative brand identity: pink/lilac/sky-blue browser face, black linework, teal shorts and orange cap/shoes. Feature the exact mascot as a modest character illustration in the Home welcome/action area; do not redraw it into a robot or let it dominate the page.
Design a coherent warm, inventive, professionally crafted workspace: almost-white paper canvas, dark charcoal typography and subtle outline structure, soft pink/lilac/sky-blue panels echoing the face, deep teal for selected controls and text links, orange with charcoal type for the main meeting action. Typography is a clean contemporary humanist sans-serif. Moderate compact density, no oversized headline, no shiny 3D, no generic purple SaaS styling, no fake graphs or repeated KPI cards. One intentional pastel gradient is welcome in the capture/welcome area. Flat graphic touches relate to the mascot, but every region serves a task.
Composition: compact left navigation with small mascot-face brand mark and "Wilco"; destinations Home, Meetings, Tasks, Memory, Settings. Slim unobtrusive header. Main content: compact greeting "Good morning, Archit"; a connected welcome band with "Bring Wilco to your next meeting", an orange "Invite Wilco" action, and the mascot around the height of the band. Below: a useful task follow-up list next to a compact upcoming meeting schedule. Show recent meeting entries with modest source/date/attendee context. Realistic sample entries "Weekly product sync", "Accessibility review", "Test Marathi read-aloud", "Review Hinglish recordings". Keep written content short and readable. Show hover/selection affordances without duplicating action buttons on every item. Balance personality and readability, fill the workspace with useful realistic content rather than decoration. Render one full desktop app view edge to edge, wide landscape, no device mockup, no photos, no design annotations, no color swatch sheet.

prompts.label: Tasks reference
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined wide desktop app UI design reference for the Wilco Tasks screen, from a fresh art direction grounded in the provided approved mascot.
Input image is brand and mascot reference, not a background image. Preserve the mascot's pastel pink/lilac/sky-blue, teal shorts, orange cap/shoes and charcoal linework as the product palette. Place a very small recognisable mascot-face mark beside "Wilco" in the left nav, with perhaps a small full-body mascot in a quiet sidebar corner. Most content space must be for work.
The user has rejected generic disconnected white cards, empty one-task screens, repeated counters and choppy expanding task grids. Design ONE connected working surface with a clear overview and one stable shared action dock, not a grid of card boxes. Friendly, inventive editorial product design with soft colour and clear alignment, never childish or glossy. Off-white canvas, fine charcoal outlines, pastel date rail, deep teal selection, orange main action with dark text. Beautiful clean humanist sans-serif.
Show slim left nav Home, Meetings, Tasks, Memory, Settings; Tasks selected. Main header "Tasks" with compact Mine/Waiting switch and "Add task". A useful calendar-like week rail above four task rows, real due dates as small typographic cues, soft selected-row highlight, a little room to breathe but not huge empty areas. Four rows: "Measure word accuracy on 20 new Hinglish recordings", "Test Marathi read-aloud with Ramesh ji", "Prepare the submission checklist", "Review the next recording sample". Keep source context hidden until selection. Under the task rows, a stable connected action dock: source "Weekly product sync", owner "You", actions "Done", "Snooze", "Reassign". The dock changes with selection and never pushes task rows around. A small useful Waiting on strip can show actual-style owner initials and counts. Subtle stage/status cues are acceptable; no invented AI scores, no graphs, no piles of filters, no giant hero, no excessive gradients.
Render one convincing full working desktop application screen, wide landscape, no device mockups, no explanatory annotations, no fake text walls, no stock photos. It should look like a delightful tool a real small team wants to use every day, with personality derived specifically from this browser mascot.
